title: Episode About the Sacrifice of Elder Sahibzadas

blocks.text: In the darkness outside Chamkaur, the Guru moved with the help of the Pathan brothers while shouts and confusion kept the enemy from recognizing him at once. A cowherd did recognize him, however, and would not be silenced even with a coin. (18–20)
When there was no other way to protect the escape, the Guru struck the man down and pressed onward. The account then turns from Chamkaur toward the next stage of exile and concealment. (21)

From there the narrative opens into Machhiwara: the Guru is brought near the town, sheltered through the service of the Pathans and Gulab Chand, and hidden within a house while a few Singhs begin to gather around him again. (Episode 20, 1–3)
